function use(x) {}

// CASE while_reader expect=pass
async function r1(it) {
	let item;
	while ((item = await it.read()) !== null) {
		use(item);
	}
}

// CASE for_reader_empty_update expect=pass
async function r2(it) {
	for (let item; (item = await it.read()) !== null; ) {
		use(item);
	}
}

// CASE for_reader_counter expect=pass
async function r3(it) {
	let count = 0;
	for (let item; (item = await it.read()) !== null; count++) {
		use(item);
	}
	return count;
}

// CASE for_cursor_update expect=pass
async function r4(api) {
	for (let c = api.start; c; c = (await api.page(c))?.next) {
		use(c);
	}
}

// CASE for_cursor_multi expect=pass
async function r5(api) {
	for (let c = api.start, n = 0; c; c = (await api.page(c))?.next, n++) {
		use(c);
	}
}

// CASE for_page_body_update expect=pass
async function r6(api) {
	for (let page = await api.first(), i = 0; page; i++) {
		use(page);
		page = await api.next(page);
	}
}

// CASE while_page_body_update expect=pass
async function r7(api) {
	let page = await api.first();
	while (page) {
		use(page);
		page = await api.next(page);
	}
}
